residual_diagnostics.limits: Ex-ante-beta diagnostic, no intercept subtraction for a different-duration future window. Not cash return, not shortable hedge, no stops or fees, no causal/significance claim. Sector/rate exposures not independently controlled.

integrity_and_accounting_audit.scope: Integrity/accounting/timing only; scenario trades repeat observations and are not independent samples. No actual quote fills or profit validation.

late_completion_recovery.finding: Initial independent audit found 38 registrations and 37 completion events although all 38 output JSON files and the summary existed. Missing final diagnostic completion only. Cause not established.
late_completion_recovery.action: Preserve original journal; append a transparently late completion for the existing unchanged diagnostic artifact using experiment_registry.complete. No backtest or diagnostic recomputed; no parameter changed.
late_completion_recovery.claim_limit: Do not claim all 38 completions were durably recorded in the original run. 38 specifications were present before the first completion.

source_archive_recovery.recovery_type: local ZIP header extraction; complete member CRC checked; original download retained
source_archive_recovery.limits: 36 CSVs and requests match original public manifest exactly. Old whole archive and all old results were NOT restored intact.
